Vignettes
Our Facilities
The Rose Garden

The centerpiece of Ecomama Farms, the Rose Garden features a diverse collection of colorful, heirloom roses with the Santa Ynez Mountains as a backdrop. The “Heart of the Garden”, our sprawling central lawn, serves as a ceremonial space perfect for exchanging vows amidst nature’s beauty. 

The Terraced Lawn

This expansive lawn offers plenty of space for multiple tables, allowing al fresco seating for up to 150 guests. With beautiful mountain views, it's an ideal setting for a picturesque outdoor reception.

The Rose Barn

This versatile space is perfect for pre-ceremony preparations, an indoor luncheon, cocktail parties and more. With a light and bright ambiance, its open air design and charming atmosphere makes it a favorite for various gatherings.

The Mountain View Barn

An indoor event space with stunning mountain views, the Mountain View Barn is perfect for hosting events that require a blend of indoor comfort and natural beauty.

The Groomsmen’s Cottage

This comfortable and elegantly furnished room adjacent to the Rose Barn provides a private space for the groom and groomsmen to relax and get ready. Its convenience and privacy make it perfect for pre-ceremony preparations.

The Bridal Loft

Located in the Mountain View Barn, this elegantly furnished loft offers ample space for the entire bridal party to get ready. With perfect lighting for hair and makeup, it also serves as a stunning backdrop for getting ready photos and quiet moments before the festivities begin.

Photo Opportunities

The Rose Arch

A picturesque spot in the Rose Garden, the Rose Arch provides a stunning backdrop for photos. It's a favorite for capturing the romantic essence of Ecomama Farms. 

The Bridge

This romantic spot is perfect for capturing intimate moments. Its idyllic setting makes it a favorite for couples and photographers alike. 

The Mountain View Oak

With its majestic presence, the Mountain View Oak serves as a great picture backdrop. Its timeless beauty adds a touch of elegance to any photo. 

The Olive Lane

Surrounded by olive trees, this flagstone path offers a serene and picturesque setting for photos. It's a charming spot that captures the timeless elegance of Ecomama Farms. 

The Pond

Currently under construction, this small pond is frequented by ducks and anchored by our Weeping Willow creating a tranquil and scenic spot. Once completed, it will be a beautiful addition to the farm's natural charm. 

The Orchard

Producing a variety of delicious, organic fruits, The Orchard is an integral part of the farm. It provides fresh, seasonal produce for guests to enjoy, and supports the farm’s ecosystem in many ways.

pages.text:
Our Story

Ecomama Farms is more than just a farm; it’s a living testament to the power of sustainability, community, and the beauty of nature. Our journey began with a dream to create a sanctuary where people and the environment thrive together. Founded in 2019 by Tamie Posnick, Ecomama has grown from a raw piece of land into a flourishing oasis of roses, biodiversity, and community spirit.

The Beginning

When we first found the property, it was far from the picturesque landscape it is today. The land was untamed and wild, an open invitation for the symbiotic relationship between farmer and soil. The beauty hidden within coupled with the room for growth felt perfect for our dream of creating a sustainable, biodynamic farm. So, like every project at Ecomama, we simply put our hands in the dirt and began.

Looking Ahead

Ecomama Farms is ever-evolving. Each season brings new growth and opportunities to expand our impact. Our goals for the future include:

Increasing biodynamic visibility

Expanding our floral offerings

Continuing to educate and engage our community on the importance of sustainability

Partnering with other organic, regenerative, and biodynamic farmers

Transformation and Growth

Over the next six years, Ecomama Farms underwent a remarkable transformation. With dedication and hard work, we expanded our rose garden to over 1500 plants, each chosen for their unique beauty and fragrance. We focused on sustainable practices, such as:

Building green structures that blend seamlessly with the natural landscape

Implementing systems to manage and conserve water effectively

Growing fruit, vegetables, flowers, and olives without the use of harmful chemicals

Creating intentional landscapes that support wildlife habitats and promote ecological balance.

Building an entire closed-system compost area to recycle and replenish the land.

pages.text:
Sustainability

At Ecomama Farms, sustainability is not just a practice; it's a way of life. Our commitment to environmental stewardship guides everything we do, from how we grow our roses to how we engage with our community. We believe in nurturing the land that nurtures us, ensuring a harmonious and regenerative relationship with nature.

Biodynamic and Regenerative Farming

Our farming practices are rooted in biodynamic and regenerative agriculture, which focus on creating a self-sustaining ecosystem. This means we aim to give back to the land as much as we take from it, fostering a cycle of renewal and growth. Here’s how we achieve this:

Closed Ecosystem

We utilize every living and non-living element on our property to contribute to new growth. This includes using plant trimmings, animal waste, and organic matter to create rich compost that nourishes our soil.

Organic Practices

We strictly avoid the use of ANY pesticides, insecticides, or synthetic fertilizer. Instead, we rely on natural methods to protect and enhance the health and vitality of plants, animals, and people by working at the slow pace of Mother Nature. We do not use anything to manipulate the growth cycle or appearance of our roses, as we value the quality and health of our plants and our soil over quantity.

Biodiversity

We grow plants that attract pollinators like birds, bees, and butterflies, promoting biodiversity and a balanced ecosystem. Even the weeds are helpful informants, providing insights into the health of our soil and enhancing microbial activity. By fostering biodiversity, we ensure a vibrant and resilient ecological community that thrives year-round. 

Water Conservation

Water is a precious resource, and we take great care to use it wisely. Our water conservation methods include:

Drip Irrigation: This efficient system delivers water directly to the roots of our plants, minimizing waste and ensuring that each drop is used effectively.

Seasonal Adjustments: We carefully coordinate with mother nature to allow rain to handle the irrigation needs and make slight adjustments manually to our irrigation to ensure never overwatering our trees and plants.

Rainwater Harvesting: We collect and store rainwater to supplement our irrigation needs, reducing our reliance on external water sources.

Waterway Management: By managing natural waterways on our property, we help maintain local water levels and support the surrounding ecosystem.

Natural Soil Enrichment

Our soil is the foundation of our farm, and we go to great lengths to keep it healthy and fertile:

Compost Tea Brews: We brew special teas customized for our different plant species made from plants, minerals and micro organisms that naturally feed, replenish, and strengthen our soil and nourish our plants.

Animal Rotation: By rotating where our animals graze, we add raw material to nourish the soil and eliminate the need for chemical fertilizers.

Cover Crops: We plant cover crops to protect and enrich the soil during off-seasons, preventing erosion and promoting biodiversity.

About Us
It started with the land.
Ecomama began with a belief that land, properly cared for, gives back more than it takes. What started as a biodynamic farm in the hills above Santa Ynez — roses, olives, orchards, and an obsession with soil health — grew into something we didn't quite plan: one of the most beautiful private estates in the valley, and a place where families began coming to mark the moments that matter.
Our Mission

Our mission at Ecomama Rose Farm is to be a model of sustainability, fostering a deep connection with the earth while creating a beautiful, community-oriented environment. We aim to:

Cultivate beauty through sustainable farming practices

Support and educate our community on the importance of environmental stewardship

Create a harmonious space for events that celebrate love, nature, and togetherness

Partner with Ecomama Farms

At Ecomama Farms, we believe in the power of collaboration and the value of strong partnerships. We are dedicated to creating memorable and sustainable events, and we welcome the opportunity to work with wedding planners and other professionals who share our vision. If you're interested in partnering with us to bring unforgettable experiences to your clients, you've come to the right place.

Why Partner with Ecomama Farms

Unique Venue

Ecomama Farms offers a one-of-a-kind venue with stunning natural beauty, sustainable practices, and versatile event spaces. Our farm provides the perfect backdrop for weddings, receptions, and special events, ensuring that each occasion is unique and memorable.

Sustainable Practices

Our commitment to biodynamic and regenerative farming not only supports the environment but also enhances the natural beauty of our land. The lush gardens, vibrant rose fields, and pristine landscapes create a timeless setting for any event.

Collaboration

We thrive on collaboration and are dedicated to working seamlessly with wedding planners and event professionals. Our venue is designed to provide a flexible and accommodating space, allowing you to bring your clients' visions to life with ease.

Preferred Vendor List

As a preferred partner, you will have access to our curated list of trusted vendors, including photographers, videographers, musicians, and more. This list helps streamline the planning process and ensures that clients receive top-quality service from professionals we trust.

How to Partner with Us

We are always looking to expand our network of talented professionals. Whether you are a wedding planner, photographer, caterer, or another event specialist, we invite you to connect with us and explore the possibilities of partnership. Follow the link below to fill out the form & get started.

Privacy Policy

Ecomama Farms ("we," "our," "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy outlines our practices regarding the collection, use, and sharing of your personal information when you visit our website, use our services, or interact with us.

1. Information We Collect

Personal Information: We collect personal information that you voluntarily provide to us, including but not limited to:

Usage Data: We automatically collect information about your interaction with our website, including:

2. How We Use Your Information

We use your personal information for the following purposes:

To provide and improve our services

To process and manage your bookings and inquiries

To communicate with you, including sending confirmations and updates

To personalize your experience on our website

To comply with legal obligations and protect our legal rights

3. Sharing Your Information

We do not sell your personal information to third parties. However, we may share your information with:

Service providers who assist us in operating our business and website

Other parties with your consent or as necessary to fulfill your requests

4. Data Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction. However, no security measures are completely secure, and we cannot guarantee the absolute security of your information.

You have the right to:

Request the deletion of your personal information, subject to legal obligations

We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience on our website. You can control the use of cookies through your browser settings. For more information, please refer to our Cookie Policy.

7. Third-Party Links

Our website may contain links to third-party websites. This Privacy Policy does not apply to those websites, and we are not responsible for their privacy practices. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of any third-party sites you visit.

8. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any significant changes by posting the updated policy on our website and updating the effective date. Your continued use of our website and services after any changes indicates your acceptance of the updated Privacy Policy.

9. Contact Us

If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or our privacy practices, please contact us at:

pages.text:
The Farm
Get to Know The Farm

Ecomama Farms is not a wedding venue that happens to have gardens. It is a working biodynamic farm that happens to host weddings — and the distinction matters. The roses in your ceremony bouquet were cut from these grounds that morning. The fruit on your dinner table came from the orchard fifty feet from the kitchen. The estate is alive in a way that most venues simply are not.

1,200 heirloom roses.

The Rose Garden is the centerpiece of the estate — both as a ceremony space and as the source of the florals that appear throughout every Ecomama wedding. Our collection of over a thousand heirloom rose varieties has been grown and cultivated on-site for years, producing blooms in a range of colors, forms, and fragrances that a floral wholesaler simply cannot match.

The Orchard.

Our passion for the land goes beyond our stunning rose gardens. Our orchard is a bountiful source of organic fruits. We cultivate a diverse range of fruits such as Apples, Peaches, Plums, Pomegranates, Almonds, Walnuts, Lemons, Apricots, Figs, Berries, and Cherries with utmost care and dedication, adhering to our biodynamic farming practices. Additionally, we nurture olive trees and craft our own cold-pressed olive oil.

Compost

At Ecomama, we aim to achieve zero waste by reusing and recycling everything we can. Our composting practices are a key part of this effort. 

Our compost is made from a combination of plant trimmings, animal waste, and organic matter, all from right here on the property. This nutrient-rich compost is used to nourish our gardens and orchards. Our compost is magical! It’s nutrient-dense and full of helpful microorganisms, and we use it seasonally to promote the healthy growth of our plants and replenishment of our soil. By turning waste into valuable resources, we maintain a closed-loop system that benefits both our farm and the environment. 

Wildlife

Our farm is a haven for wildlife. We have intentionally created habitats that support a diverse range of species, from birds and bees to butterflies and beneficial insects. These natural inhabitants play a vital role in pollination and pest control, helping to maintain the health and balance of our farm. By fostering biodiversity, we ensure a vibrant and resilient ecosystem that thrives year-round.

Eco-Conscious Structures

Our commitment to sustainability extends to the structures on our farm. We have built eco-conscious facilities that blend seamlessly with the natural landscape. From our event venues to our on-site accommodations, each structure is designed with sustainability in mind. We use renewable materials, energy-efficient systems, and eco-friendly construction methods to minimize our environmental footprint.

Farm Animals

Our farm is home to a variety of animals, including chickens, ducks, turkeys, goats, pigs, cats, and rescued animals. Our animals are cared for with the utmost respect and love, reflecting our commitment to ethical and sustainable practices. Meet some of our animal friends:
